Practised safe drinking-water storage: clean, covered containers.
Discussed using a ladle or tap instead of hands.

end.parentNote: Asha practised safe water storage through repeated questions and explanations. Pari correctly explained covering the container, using a ladle, washing hands, and keeping the container raised to reduce dirt and insects. One early response focused mainly on closing the tap; this was corrected later by explaining container safety and ladle use. At home, ask Pari to name two rules for storing drinking water and demonstrate them with a bottle or matka.
